description: Read a public web page as clean Markdown for an LLM: the main content only (navigation, footers, sidebars, cookie banners, forms and comments removed), with headings, lists, GFM tables, code blocks, and links and images as absolute URLs. Also returns the title, canonical and final URL, language, byline and published date when the page states them, the meta/OpenGraph description, every JSON-LD block, and a word count. Markdown is capped at 60,000 characters (truncated flag). JavaScript is never run: a client-rendered page with no server HTML content is refused and not charged.

url.description: The page: any public http or https address serving HTML.

name: read_page
